claims.scope: BuilderWallet.init() initialization and builderAdmin takeover leading to sweep() drain

preconditions.derivation: 未能生成忠实的形式化前提。

safety.text: Setting the builderAdmin address via init() should be restricted to an authorized caller so that an arbitrary user cannot overwrite builderAdmin.; Tokens held by BuilderWallet should not be drainable by an unauthorized party through sweep().
safety.derivation: 未能为该影响生成忠实的安全关系。
evidence: The `init()` function in the `BuilderWallet` contract lacks any access control checks. This allows any arbitrary user to call the function and overwrite the `builderAdmin` address repeatedly.
Add access control và initialization check
An attacker can take over the `builderAdmin` role and use the `sweep()` function to drain all tokens from the `BuilderWallet`.

effects.text: An attacker can take over the builderAdmin role.
